review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 14, 12:59 PM ET. It had Kraken 34% and Hurricanes 66%, projecting Kraken 2.6 – Hurricanes 3.6 (6.2 total, Hurricanes by 1).

Final: Kraken 1 – Hurricanes 5. Right winner: it had Hurricanes at 66%.

review.title: How the ratings held up
review.body:
Kraken came in with a 2% below average attack and a 3% leakier than average defense (9-7-1, 3.4 scored and 3.6 allowed a game over 17 games), worth about 76 and 76 games of evidence. Projected to score 2.6, they scored 1 (−1.6 goals, 61% under); projected to allow 3.6, they allowed 5 (+1.4 goals, 40% over).

Hurricanes came in with a 12% above average attack and a 7% stingier than average defense (15-3-2, 4.1 scored and 2.3 allowed a game over 20 games), worth about 78 and 77 games of evidence. Projected to score 3.6, they scored 5 (+1.4 goals, 40% over); projected to allow 2.6, they allowed 1 (−1.6 goals, 61% under).

The bigger miss was Kraken's scoring (-1.6 goals against projection).

review.title: Where the result sat in the simulations
review.body:
Total: 6 against 6.2 projected (-0.2), about the 47th percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±2.5).

Margin: Hurricanes by 4 against Hurricanes by 1 projected, about the 89th percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±2.5).

An unusual result, but one the simulations saw regularly (roughly one game in six to one in twenty).
